name: Shoe repair and cobblers
summary: How expats find cobblers in Singapore for sole replacements, heel tips, and bag repairs — mall kiosks vs workshop quality, turnaround, and when repair beats replacing tropical-wear shoes.
body:
Heat, rain, and MRT miles destroy heels and glued soles faster than many temperate cities. Cobblers and shoe-repair kiosks handle resoling, stitching, zipper swaps, and some leather-bag fixes.

## Typical jobs
- Heel tips and sole replacements
- Stretching and minor fitting tweaks
- Bag zippers and strap repairs
- Deep cleaning / colour restoration (variable quality)
- School shoe emergency fixes

Ask whether adhesives used tolerate humidity and how waterproofing is claimed.

## How to choose
Workshop cobblers often outlast pure polish kiosks for structural jobs. Get quotes before leaving premium shoes. Turnaround of 3–10 days is common; rush fees exist before travel. Photograph damage for insurance if shoes were airline-damaged.

## Practical tip
Keep a spare office pair at work during monsoon weeks. Resole favourites early — waiting until the midsole is gone raises cost past replacement.
